en.headline: Tourism chief confident Hong Kong will hit 53.8 million visitor target
en.dek: Rosanna Law said the first seven months delivered solid growth despite July rain and higher fuel costs, with the traditional peak season still ahead.
body: Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law said on Saturday she remained confident that Hong Kong would meet its full-year target of 53.8 million visitor arrivals. Speaking on an RTHK radio programme, she noted that the first seven months of 2026 had already recorded about 31.22 million arrivals.

Law acknowledged that July saw rain on 28 of 31 days and that Middle East tensions had pushed up fuel costs, yet the month still posted an increase in arrivals. She pointed to the traditional fourth-quarter peak, plus meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions as well as major events, as reasons for optimism about the second half of the year.

She also said sports-related revenue was expected to keep rising after the opening of Kai Tak Sports Park, which has already hosted international sevens rugby and large football matches, generating income from tickets, broadcasting and visitors. Retail performance at the Kai Tak retail pavilion in the first quarter had risen 40 per cent up to May, she added.

zh.headline: 羅淑佩有信心全年達5380萬人次訪港目標
zh.dek: 文化體育及旅遊局局長指首七個月已錄得約3122萬人次，即使7月多雨及燃油成本上升，仍對下半年旺季有信心。
body: 文化體育及旅遊局局長羅淑佩周六在電台節目表示，有信心香港全年可達到5380萬人次旅客訪港的目標。她指出，今年首七個月已錄得約3122萬人次。
羅淑佩承認7月31天中有28天下雨，加上中東局勢令燃油成本上升，但該月旅客人次仍錄得增幅。她指本港第四季屬傳統旅遊旺季，下半年亦有會展旅遊及盛事旅遊等，相信可達預期數字。
她又表示，啟德體育園開幕後已舉辦國際七人欖球賽及大型足球比賽等，門票、電視轉播及旅客收益均有增加，預料本港體育活動收益將持續上升。截至5月，啟德零售館首季人流及零售表現錄得四成增長。
